jobs: the worker claims queued jobs (docs/JOBS.md step 1d)

forge job start without --now already enqueued a job as `queued`; now the worker's claim loop picks up queued jobs alongside tasks, within the same --jobs cap, and runs them through src/job.rs the same way --now does inline. A job's own failure (job::drive never returns an error) is recorded on the job and never propagates to env_error or any task, and a double-SIGINT abort requeues in-flight jobs the same way it requeues tasks.

forge project show and forge stats gain a jobs rollup (today, ok, failed, needs_human) scoped to the last rolling 24h, counted separately from the task counts.
